penalties.authority: Commissioner of Customs and Central Tax(Appeals I), Hyderabad
penalties.details: DRI Hyd initiated inquiry in connection with DBK and MEIS claimed by the Company during 2021-22 and asked the Company to submit export proceeds realization particulars in respect of all Shipping Bills (SB) filed during the said period. Dispute is with regard to 5 Shipping Bills where department could not trace Bank Realization Certificates (BRC) in DGFT portal. Consequently company was asked to surrender full Drawback claimed on these Shipping Bills amounting to Rs. 2,51,498/- along with interest in respect of said shipping bills. Further penalty of Rs. 10,000/- was also imposed. (Case was reported in Q1 2025-26)
penalties.impact: No impact of it and the Company is intending to pay this penalty to close the issue.

operating_notes.text: CuraTeQ Biologics secured Health Canada NOC for Bevqolva bevacizumab biosimilar.
Dr. Sanjay Chaturvedi resigned as CEO of Apitoria Pharma Private Limited.
US FDA classified Unit-VII at Jedcherla as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI), concluding the inspection.
Buyback extinguished 54,23,728 shares at ₹1,475 each (₹800 Cr); post-buyback capital is 57,53,77,895 shares and promoter stake 51.88%.

CDSCO granted Form CT 23 Marketing Authorisation for Bevqolva (bevacizumab biosimilar) to CuraTeQ Biologics, for metastatic carcinoma of the colon or rectum, with manufacture at Hyderabad and 100 mg/4mL and 400 mg/16 mL vial presentations.
Board approved transfer of domestic branded generic formulations business to Auropharm Limited via slump sale effective April 1, 2026.
US FDA classified Unit-I of Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited at Shameerpet as Official Action Indicated (OAI).
Europe formulations achieved €1 billion revenue milestone in FY26.
Inaugurated TheraNym Biologics CMO facility in Borapatla, Telangana, equipped with 15 KL bioreactors, aseptic fill-finish, and MSD as anchor customer.
Received final USFDA approval for Tofacitinib Tablets (5 mg and 10 mg) with an estimated US market size of US$ 494 million as of April 2026.
Total USFDA ANDA approvals reached 586 (561 final) as of June 4, 2026.
Lannett US plant utilisation is about 40%, with capacity to make up to 350 million units without major capex.
PEN-G production is running at 800-900 tonnes, with capacity for 15,000 tonnes and Indian demand around 9,000-10,000 tonnes.
China OSD facility has capacity above 2 billion tablets and has doubled output over the past 12 months.

timeline.summary: Aurobindo Pharma announced a ₹800 crore share buyback at ₹1,475 per share, scheduling the tender offer from April 23 to April 29, 2026.
Aurobindo Pharma's subsidiary CuraTeQ Biologics secured Health Canada NOC for its bevacizumab biosimilar, Bevqolva.
Dr. Sanjay Chaturvedi resigned as CEO of Aurobindo Pharma's subsidiary Apitoria Pharma effective May 4, 2026.
Aurobindo Pharma received an EIR from the US FDA classifying its Jedcherla Unit-VII facility as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI), successfully closing the inspection.
Aurobindo Pharma Limited’s **B. Adi Reddy** scheduled an earnings call on **May 22, 2026, at 8:30 AM (IST)** for Q4FY26 audited results.
Aurobindo Pharma completed its ₹800 Cr buyback, extinguishing 54,23,728 shares at ₹1,475 each on 14 May 2026 and cutting its share capital to 57,53,77,895 shares.

Aurobindo Pharma's wholly owned subsidiary CuraTeQ Biologics received CDSCO Marketing Authorisation (Form CT 23) for its bevacizumab biosimilar Bevqolva, permitting manufacture in Hyderabad and marketing in India.
The Telangana High Court dismissed promoters' writ petition against SEBI's ₹6.53 Cr profit deposit directive.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹8,853.34 Cr (+5.6% YoY), net profit ₹920.84 Cr (+2.0% YoY).
Aurobindo Pharma's step-down subsidiary Agile Pharma BV incorporated Arrow Pharma Production SAS in France with a capital of 100,000 EUR.
US FDA classified Eugia Pharma Specialities' Unit-I at Shameerpet as Official Action Indicated (OAI) following a February 2026 inspection.
Aurobindo Pharma reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹8,853 Cr and net profit of ₹921 Cr, while achieving €1 billion revenue in Europe for FY26.
Aurobindo Pharma inaugurated TheraNym, its large-scale biologics CMO facility in Telangana, with MSD as its anchor customer.
Aurobindo Pharma received final USFDA approval for Tofacitinib Tablets (5 mg and 10 mg) for the US market.
Aurobindo Pharma's Q1FY27 earnings call reiterated FY27 guidance of double-digit revenue growth and EBITDA above ₹8,000 Cr, with Q1 revenue up 16% to ₹9,150 Cr.
Aurobindo Pharma Limited scheduled its Earnings Call on November 5, 2026 at 8:30 AM IST.
